heavy_weapon_harness.name: Heavy weapon harness
description: ## Heavy weapon harness
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=9000 t=Light w=10 b=1 d=6 c=1 f=5 s=30 z=20}
Known also as an "H-belt," a *heavy weapon harness* is an elaborate network of plastic and metal struts and straps.

@I-warning The *harness* can be worn in conjunction with any other suit of armor - the armor bonus granted by the *heavy weapon harness* does not stack with that granted by other suits of armor, but the armor check penalties and spell failure percentages do.

@I-boost A *heavy weapon harness* provides its wearer with additional stability and support, allowing the user to wield heavy weapons as if they were regular firearms, using the ‹feat/Exotic Weapon<_proficiency› (firearms) feat for proficiency rather than Exotic Weapon (heavy weaponry). A character with Exotic Weapon (heavy weaponry) who wears an H-belt finds the use of heavy weapons even easier, and gains a +1 circumstance bonus on all attack rolls made with harnessed heavy weapons.
@I-info Unlike most technological armors, a *heavy weapon harness* does not use power - its components are purely mechanical.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=27 p=4500 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>military» lab<oratories›"}

scatterlight_suit_brown.name: Scatterlight Suit (brown)
description: ## Scatterlight suit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=Varies v t=Light w=5 b="+1 (and see text)" d=8 c=1 f=5 s=30 z=20 y=24 u="1 charge/hour"}

A *scatterlight suit* is a tight, form-fitting suit of highly reflective polymers and synthetic metal fibers. It's designed to reflect beam weapon attacks, and provides only minimal protection against physical damage.

@I-def-info Activating a *scatterlight suit* is a @SA; once activated, the suit diffuses and blurs light reflected from its surface, making the wearer appear hazy and indistinct. While active, a *scatterlight suit* increases the wearer's touch AC by a variable amount - this bonus is an armor bonus, but does not increase the wearer's normal or flat-footed AC beyond the *scatterlight suit's* baseline armor bonus of +1. This bonus to touch AC only applies to attacks made by beam weapons and rays - it does not provide additional protection to other touch attacks.
| Scatterlight Suit Color | Touch AC Bonus | Cost | Craft DC | Craft Cost |
::tabular{format=techcraft c="(see above)" p="(see above)" v r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>military» lab<oratories›"}

chameleon_suit.name: Chameleon suit
description: ## Chameleon suit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=15000 t=Light w=5 b=2 d=6 c=0 f=10 s=30 z=20 y=50 u="1 charge/minute"}
This suit of light woven-fiber armor covers the wearer from ankle to wrist and includes a hooded cowl. Its surface consists of millions of tiny, scale-like lenses and LED screens.

@I-def When powered on, a *chameleon suit* analyzes its environment and generates digital camouflage. The wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks and can *hide in plain sight* (as a ‹class/ranger› in his ‹ability/favored terrain›).
::tabular{format=techcraft c=29 p=7500 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>military» lab<oratories›"}

neraplast_armor.name: Neraplast armor
description: ## Neraplast armor
‹SOURCE Pathfinder #85: Fires of Creation/60›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=1200 t=Light w=5 b=2 d=8 c=0 f=5 s=30 z=20 y=24 u="1 charge"}
This lightweight, form-fitting bodysuit features a variety of pockets, straps, and a built-in interface for automatically adjusting the various colors and patterns on its fabric.
Selecting a color or pattern is a @RA that consumes 1 charge and provokes an attack of opportunity.

@I-def-info Capable of cycling through dozens of hues, the armor can even be used to adopt sophisticated camouflage patterns that grant a +3 competence bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks. Whenever the wearer enters a terrain of significantly different coloration and background patterns, the armor must be recalibrated to its current area to maintain this bonus.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=22 p=600 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>production» lab<oratories›"}

deep_diving_suit.name: Deep diving suit
description: ## Deep diving suit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=26000 t=Light w=20 b=3 d=5 c=2 f=30 s=30 z=20 y=25 u="1 charge/hour"}

A *deep diving suit* is a body-tight mesh of reinforced rubber and polymer fitted with scrubbers that can draw and purify oxygen from its surrounding environment, extracting oxygen from water as easily as from air.

@I-def The suit's helmet is close-fitting but offers excellent visibility, while the suit's fabric itself can flex while still remaining supportive against pressure - depths are treated as being 1,000 feet shallower than their actual depth for the purposes of determining ‹rule/pressure damage› from deep water. The wearer is also immune to inhaled toxins and can breathe underwater with ease - the suit does not allow breathing in a vacuum.

@I-power-boost-down A *diving suit's* hands and feet can activate webbing, long fins, and flippers, which the wearer can extend (and deactivate) as a @MA. While in this mode, the wearer of the suit gains a swim speed of 20 feet and a +8 bonus on ‹skill/Swim› checks, but the armor check penalty of the suit doubles to -4 and its land speed reduces to 20 feet (or 15 feet for slower characters, as appropriate). Swim checks are never penalized by a *diving suit's* armor check penalty.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=26 p=13000 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>production» lab<oratories›"}

inssuit.name: Inssuit
description: ## Inssuit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=19250 t=Light w=10 b=3 d=6 c=0 f=15 s=30 z=20}
This padded jumpsuit is made of resilient polymers interwoven with superconducting thread. It provides modest protection from conventional and energy weapons.

@I-def The wearer applies the armor's AC bonus (including enhancement bonus, if any) against touch and ranged touch attacks that deal energy damage. In addition, the *inssuit* provides ‹umr/resist› energy 5 against cold, acid, and electricity.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=24 p=9625 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>military» lab<oratories›"}

smart_armor_compact_form.name: Smart Armor (compact form)
description: ## Smart armor
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
### Compact form
::tabular{format=techarmor p=16500 t=Light w=20 b=4 d=4 c=2 f=25 s=30 z=20}
### Expanded form
::tabular{format=techarmor p=16500 t=Heavy w=20 b=8 d=1 c=5 f=35 s=20 z=15 y=60 u="1 charge/10 minutes"}

While inactive, *smart armor* resembles a ‹eq-armor/breastplate› of ‹eq-material/adamantine› scales, which doesn't seem out of place among the metal armor of Golarion, except for its the alien aesthetics of its Androffan design.

@I-def When activated as an @IA, *smart armor* expands to cover the wearer's legs and limbs, and a built-in magnetic generator hardens the armor into a rigid, plate-like form. When in this form, it uses the statistics of *smart armor (expanded form).* It can be collapsed back to breastplate form with a @MA, and automatically retracts when it loses power.
@I-def In either form, *smart armor* provides DR 2/- due to its adamantine construction. *Smart armor* is considered ‹rule/masterwork armor›.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=28 p=1400 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>military» lab<oratories›"}

gravity_suit.name: Gravity suit
description: ## Gravity suit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=40000 t=Light w=5 b=Varies d=8 c=0 f=5 s=30 z=20 y=24 u="1 charge/hour"}

A *gravity suit* consists of several black, flexible straps attached to a framework of delicate servos, thin plates, and small strips of black polymer plastic - this give it an appearance of being ineffective armor.

@I-def The armor bonus provided by an unpowered *gravity suit* is +0, but when activated, the suit generates a field of gravitons around the wearer that grants a +5 armor bonus (this bonus is a force effect). This bonus is doubled when it applies to the wearer's CMD score against ‹rule/bull rush›, ‹rule/overrun›, and ‹rule/trip› attempts, and slows any fall as if the wearer were under the effect of a ‹spell/feather fall› spell.
@I-power At the cost of 1 additional charge per minute, the wearer of a *gravity suit* can fly at a speed of 60 ft. (average). Activating this ability is a @SA.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=33 p=20000 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>graviton» lab<oratories›"}

panic_suit.name: Panic suit
description: ## Panic suit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=2000 t=Medium w=2 b=2 d=2 c=4 f=50 s=20 z=15 y=10 u="1 charge/hour, disposable"}
When not being worn, a *panic suit* is a fist-sized plastic sphere. When activated, it envelops the creature holding it in a full-body protective suit.

@I-def While activated, it provides immunity to low ‹rule/radiation› and ‹umr/resistance› 5 against all forms of energy except sonic damage. Its air filters grant a +4 bonus on saving throws against inhaled poisons and diseases.
A *panic suit* is a single-use item. When its charges run out or its wearer deactivates it, it falls apart into useless fragments.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=30 p=1000 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>military» lab<oratories›"}

hev_suit.name: HEV suit
description: ## HEV suit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=61000 t=Medium w=20 b=4 d=3 c=4 f=40 s=20 z=15 y=25 u="1 charge/hour"}

Short for "hazardous environment," an *HEV suit* provides protection from ‹rule/radiation›, disease, poisonous gas, cold, heat, and similar environmental dangers. The suit needs a power supply to work - while deactivated, none of the following abilities function at all.

@I-def While powered, the suit provides immunity to inhaled poisons and diseases, and provides resistance 10 against all forms of energy except for sonic damage. An *HEV suit* completely protects against low radiation, and reduces the effects of medium radiation to low radiation, but it offers no protection against high or severe radiation.

@I-aid-warning The suit's self-repairing polymer resin fabric automatically seals secondary punctures or tears created by physical attacks to the wearer and damage dealt specifically against the suit. It repairs damage at the rate of 2d6 points of damage per charge consumed. While repairing damage in this manner, the suit's other protective functions listed above are any taken offline.
An *HEV suit* has ‹rule/hardness› 2 and 30 hit points.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=28 p=30500 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>production» lab<oratories›"}

nanite_ablative_armor.name: Nanite ablative armor
description: ## Nanite ablative armor
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=10000 t=Medium w=35 b=4 d=4 c=3 f=20 s=20 z=15 y=24 u="1 charge/hour"}

This suit of armor consists of several layers of scaly mesh over a thick, cloth-like polymer weave. When activated, a suit of *nanite ablative armor* grants the wearer additional protection against nanites, through the use of imperceptible magnetic fields that repel the microscopic robots.

@I-def An active suit of *nanite ablative armor* grants its armor bonus (including any enhancement bonuses) to the wearer's touch AC against nanites. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws made against nanite-related effects delivered through means other than touch attacks.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=30 p=5000 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>graviton» lab<oratories›"}

spacesuit.name: Spacesuit
description: ## Spacesuit
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=90000 t=Heavy w=35 b=7 d=0 c=8 f=50 s=20 z=15 y=25 u="1 charge/hour"}

@I-info This airtight suit of synthetic polymers includes a transparent, dome-like helmet that completely covers the wearer's head. A *spacesuit* is nearly identical in function to an ‹tech-armor/HEV suit›, except that as long as the *spacesuit* is charged, it provides a bit more armor protection as well as complete protection from all ‹rule/radiation› and exposure to vacuum. A *spacesuit* repairs damage to itself at the rate of 4d6 points of damage per charge consumed. It has ‹rule/hardness› 6 and 60 hit points.

@I-power A *spacesuit* is fitted with numerous small booster jets that grant the wearer a fly speed of 20 ft. (poor) in areas of zero gravity while the *spacesuit* is charged. The boosters impart no benefit in areas of high, low, or normal gravity.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=30 p=45000 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>military» lab<oratories›"}

hard_light_shield.name: Hard light shield
description: ## Hard light shield
‹SOURCE Technology Guide/30›
::tabular{format=techarmor p=6400 t=Shield w=1 b=2 c=0 f=10 y=20 u="1 charge/minute"}
This bulky bracelet is covered in blinking blue lights and pulsing holographic emitters. A *hard light shield* produces a translucent but substantial holographic barrier when activated.

@I-def-info The shield bonus counts as a force effect and applies to the wielder's touch AC against beam and ray attacks (but not other touch attacks). As a transparent force effect, a *hard light shield* provides no bonus against lasers. A hard light shield can be used to deliver ‹misc/shield bash› attacks like a ‹eq-armor/heavy<_steel> shield›.

@I-warning When turned off, a *hard light shield* provides no AC bonus and imposes no spell failure chance. Activating or deactivating a *hard light shield* is a @MA. This item occupies the wearer's ‹rule/wrist slot›.
::tabular{format=techcraft c=27 p=3200 r="‹feat/Craft Technological Arms and Armor›, ‹rule/crafting>graviton» lab<oratories›"}
